entries.speaker: The Sixth Heist: Sae
entries.en: The Phantom Thieves are blamed for Okumura's[n]death, and their popularity plummets. The[n]police put a 30 million yen [clr 2]bounty on their[n]heads[clr 27].

entries.speaker: The Sixth Heist: Sae
entries.en: Despite his vocal opposition to them, Akechi[n]declares the Phantom Thieves are not the[n]culprits behind Okumura's death, but hints[n]that he knows who is...

entries.speaker: The Sixth Heist: Sae
entries.en: The Phantom Thieves call Akechi with the hope[n]of clearing their name, but he forces them[n]to aid him in his plan to give Sae a change[n]of heart.
